labeling: Source-only authored before installing, building or instrumenting these projects. No generated schemas or compiler metadata inspected. Same development agent; no independent-human adjudication.

sourceAuthoredSecurityBoundaries.expected: Without explicit approved capabilities, catalog/actions reveal no private app values and perform no domain writes.
Denied operation leaves frozen business storage and unrelated rows unchanged.
A required approval cannot be bypassed by ordinary tool calls or by an agent supplying its own grant token.
Expired/revoked authorization cannot execute the action; storage remains unchanged.
An authorization or target handle from browser/user A cannot authorize a write in browser/user B; B data and A data remain unchanged.
Audit records describe identity/operation/outcome without plaintext input passwords or complete private business payloads.

knownLimits: Summary/read-only presentation and RouterLink navigation are setup/context, not labelled writes.
Native form submission has no business add handler; use the separately authored Add click.
